25% Increased damage and causes enemies to explode on death, dealing <pve 444 /> <pvp [163] /> damage in a [?] meter radius.

enhanced (

)

被动提升 +30 弹匣容量。
（等效于一个加长弹匣）

enhanced (
#e 被动提升 +5 稳定性。
)
